title: A Cordes framework for stationary Fokker--Planck--Kolmogorov equations
summary: We first review the Cordes condition for nondivergence-form differential operators through the lens of Campanato's theory of near operators. We then survey a recently proposed Cordes framework that guarantees the existence and uniqueness of $L^2$ solutions to stationary Fokker--Planck--Kolmogorov equations subject to periodic boundary conditions, and that allows for the construction of a simple finite element method for its numerical approximation.
